text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan Keselamatan

Sosial Pekerjaan Sendiri (Perbekalan) 2020.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2020

2. Pengeluaran sejumlah wang yang tidak melebihi sebelas juta enam ratus

tujuh puluh satu ribu ringgit (RM11,671,000) daripada Kumpulan Wang Keselamatan

Sosial Pekerjaan Sendiri bagi perbelanjaan untuk pentadbiran Skim Keselamatan Sosial

Pekerjaan Sendiri bagi tahun 2020 adalah dengan ini dibenarkan bagi maksud yang

dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Maksud Amaun

(RM)

Emolumen 2,845,000

Bekalan dan perkhidmatan 3,031,000

Perbelanjaan lain 1,673,000

Harta tanah, loji dan kelengkapan 4,122,000

Jumlah 11,671,000

Dibuat 1 September 2020

[KSM/PUU/(S)/600-1/2/27/6; PN(PU2)744/III]

DATUK SERI SARAVANAN A/L MURUGAN

Menteri Sumber Manusia

SELF-EMPLOYMENT SOCIAL SECURITY ACT 2017

 SELF-EMPLOYMENT SOCIAL SECURITY (SUPPLY) REGULATIONS 2020

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 47(1) of the

Self-Employment Social Security Act 2017 [Act 789], the Minister makes the

following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Self-Employment Social Security (Supply)

Regulations 2020.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2020

2. The issue of a sum not exceeding eleven million six hundred and seventy-one

thousand ringgit (RM11,671,000) from the Self-Employment Social Security Fund for the

expenditure on administration of the Self-Employment Social Security Scheme

for the year 2020 is hereby authorized for the purposes specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Purposes Amount

(RM)

Emoluments 2,845,000

Supplies and services 3,031,000

Other expenditures 1,673,000

Landed properties, plants and equipment 4,122,000

Total 11,671,000

Made 1 September 2020

[KSM/PUU/(S)/600-1/2/27/6; PN(PU2)744/III]

DATUK SERI SARAVANAN A/L MURUGAN

 Minister of Human Resources
